title: Practice: review a batch of assistant conversations (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a mixed batch gets every count the segments and a verdict
cases.says: A mixed batch gets every count, the segments and a verdict

cases.id: e1 an empty batch has zero figures and is held for lack of data
cases.says: An empty batch has zero figures and is held for lack of data

cases.id: e2 a safety signal counts as missed unless it went to a person as a safety hand off
cases.says: A safety signal counts as missed unless it went to a person as a safety hand-off

cases.id: e3 a conversation is overlong only above the turn limit and only when nobody took over
cases.says: A conversation is overlong only above the turn limit and only when nobody took over

cases.id: e4 repeated questions are acceptable at exactly the limit and not above it
cases.says: Repeated questions are acceptable at exactly the limit and not above it

cases.id: e5 a segment is weak only below the resolution floor and not at it
cases.says: A segment is weak only below the resolution floor and not at it

cases.id: e6 a segment needs the minimum number of conversations before it can be called weak
cases.says: A segment needs the minimum number of conversations before it can be called weak

cases.id: e7 a hand off is over escalation only when no person was needed and no safety signal was present
cases.says: A hand-off is over-escalation only when no person was needed and no safety signal was present

cases.id: e8 only conversations the assistant settled alone count as resolved
cases.says: Only conversations the assistant settled alone count as resolved

cases.id: e9 percentages are whole numbers rounded half up
cases.says: Percentages are whole numbers rounded half up
